name: SharkShell
description: SharkShell is a self-hosted web SSH terminal with an encrypted keystore, multi-user organizations, TOTP 2FA, terminal scrollback restore, and a built-in MCP server so AI assistants can manage your servers.

notes.text: The first account you register becomes the organization admin; open registration is disabled automatically afterward.

The upload ceiling defaults to 50GB in both /opt/sharkshell/.env (MAX_UPLOAD_GB) and the nginx client_max_body_size in /etc/nginx/sites-available/sharkshell. Raising it requires editing both, then: systemctl reload nginx && systemctl restart sharkshell.
Includes a built-in MCP server so AI assistants (Claude, etc.) can manage the servers registered in SharkShell. See the repository's docs/MCP.md for setup.
